  • Method Details

    • fromEnum

      static <E extends Enum<E>> List<? extends Tree.StringParser.NodeParser<? extends E>> fromEnum(Class<E> enumClass, boolean allowVoid)
      Builds a list of NodeParsers, one for each value of the provided enumClass, which will produce enum values of that class when matching their corresponding string representations. Optionally, each parser can allow for empty content (i.e., "\\s*") before the match, by setting allowVoid.
      Type Parameters:
      E - the type of the enum values produced by the parsers
      Parameters:
      enumClass - the class of the enum to build the parsers for
      allowVoid - a flag for setting whether to accept empty content before a match
      Returns:
      a list of NodeParsers, one for each value of the provided enumClass

    • fromRegex

      static <L> Tree.StringParser.NodeParser<? extends L> fromRegex(String regex, Function<String, ? extends L> builder, boolean allowVoid)
      Builds a NodeParser which works by looking for a match of a provided regex and the transforming that match in a label through a provided builder. Optionally, it can allow for empty content (i.e., "\\s*") before the match, by setting allowVoid.
      Type Parameters:
      L - the type of parsed labels
      Parameters:
      regex - the regex for matching the content to extract
      builder - the function mapping a matched content to a label
      allowVoid - a flag for setting whether to accept empty content before a match
      Returns:
      a parser based on the provided regex and builder

    • parse

      Optional<Tree.StringParser.Token<L>> parse(String s, int i)
      Attempts to parse a token in the provided string s at index i
      Parameters:
      s - the string being parsed
      i - the index of the string to parse at
      Returns:
      the result of the parsing, empty if no token was found, with a Token otherwise
